notes: Maximum aggregate data rate 425 Gb/s. Bit error ratio max 2.4E-4 per IEEE P802.3cu. Reach Lmax1 0.002–2 km on SMF per G.652. Average launch power each lane min -3.2 dBm is informative; max 4.4 dBm per lane; total average launch power max 10.4 dBm. Receiver sensitivity (OMAouter) each lane max -4.6 dBm for SECQ < 1.4 dB; for 1.4 dB ≤ SECQ ≤ 3.4 dB sensitivity is -6 + SECQ dBm; -2.6 dBm measured with conformance test signal at TP3 per note 3. Stressed receiver test uses SECQ 3.4 dB and OMAouter of each aggressor lane 1.5 dBm. Power dissipation <12 W; module total power max 12 W across full temperature and voltage range. Supply 3.3 V (3.135–3.465 V). Case operating temperature C-temp 0 to +70 °C. Storage -40 to +85 °C. Receiver damage threshold per lane 5.4 dBm; average receive power each lane -7.2 to 4.4 dBm. Applications state 400G FR4 with FEC but FEC type not specified. Vendor branding Finisar; copyright Coherent Corp.
